name: Leon Sans · Leon Sans

title.zh: Leon Sans · 在Canvas画布上用代码绘

description.zh: 看本程序原生Canvas Basic真实绘字结果。 Leon Sans是Jongmin Kim以代码写成的几何无衬线字形实现，以在HTML5 Canvas/WebGL中绘制文字的JavaScript程序形式提供，而非传统字体文件。代码仓库以MIT许可发布，并附在线示例演示字重与动画效果。
description.en: Leon Sans is a geometric sans-serif letterform implementation written in code by Jongmin Kim, provided as a JavaScript program that draws text in HTML5 Canvas / WebGL rather than as conventional font files. Its repository is released under the MIT License, with live examples showing weight and animation effects.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Leon Sans (https://leon-kim.com/).
Technology stack: canvas, javascript, webgl.
Component specification: 看本程序原生Canvas Basic真实绘字结果。

Visual details from source observation: 我们先看首页的细线字样，再到Examples比较Canvas与WebGL目录，当前all视图实际排出大小写字母、数字和符号。Canvas Basic把一段英文画成三行，右上保留字重、字号和颜色控件。适合前端做可编程文字呈现；本次未切换全部示例、修改控件或下载传统字体。代码与字形坐标按MIT分发须留版权许可，价格仍未知。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
